summary: Canadian-born physician Peter Attia left surgical training to build a pricey US concierge longevity practice, podcast and bestseller, promoting thinly evidenced testing and drugs, until 2026 files exposed his ties to Jeffrey Epstein.

evidence.note: extended placement of Attia within the manosphere, biohacker and wellness spheres
concierge medicine shrinking access to care as a public health problem
born in Toronto in 1973 to Egyptian immigrant parents; childhood segment follows
unauthorized gentamicin dosing change during residency, then quitting surgery
long McKinsey segment on its opioid work for Purdue and the settlements
opens his private longevity clinic in 2014; podcast from 2018, book 2023
harms of over-testing, early colonoscopy, off-label rapamycin and glucose monitors
Epstein files segment: 2014 meeting, emails, referrals, CBS exit in 2026
candidate Epstein introduced for a job was one of his victims
2026 fallout: sponsors drop him and a lawsuit with Oura is ongoing

notes: main_span start 2006 is an estimate for leaving Hopkins residency and joining McKinsey; the transcript gives no year. sexual-abuse and child-abuse cover the Epstein segment (victims included adults and minors); no content warning added because abuse is discussed, not described in detail. medical-malpractice used for unauthorized dosing and over-testing harms; the host explicitly says Attia is not a quack.
